topic: General Claim Intimation and Assistance Process
guidance: Crop insurance assistance typically involves timely loss intimation, joint field survey, and assessment against scheme criteria. Specific intimation windows (e.g. 72 hours for localized natural calamities under certain schemes) and procedures can vary depending on whether the loss is localized, post-harvest, or seasonal.
information_to_collect: Exact date, estimated time, and primary cause of crop damage
Insured crop name, variety, and approximate affected acreage
Village, Mandal/Tehsil, District, and Plot/Survey/Khasra number
Insurance policy number, application reference, or bank account number used for premium deduction
useful_evidence: Intimation reference / grievance docket number received from the official toll-free helpline or portal
Written intimation copy acknowledged with date and stamp by the local Agriculture Officer or bank branch
Joint field survey report copy signed during the official surveyor and agriculture officer field inspection
general_next_steps: Promptly notify the insurance company via official toll-free helpline, designated government portal, or the nearest Agriculture Extension Office
Carefully note down and preserve the official registration or complaint docket number provided
Be present and cooperate with the joint survey team (Agriculture department official + Insurer representative) during the field visit
Obtain an acknowledged copy or receipt of the field survey assessment sheet

guidance: Official crop insurance processes do not charge unauthorized processing fees or commissions for registering loss intimations or carrying out field surveys. Farmers should always verify surveyor credentials and avoid dealing with unauthorized intermediaries promising guaranteed payouts.
information_to_collect: Full name, designation, and official organization of any visiting surveyor or loss assessor
Official identity card or district authorization letter displayed by the inspection team
useful_evidence: Official inspection sheet bearing the official logo, surveyor signature, and date
System-generated SMS confirmation from the official state or national crop insurance portal
general_next_steps: Never pay any fee, commission, or bribe to private individuals or intermediaries claiming to guarantee claim approval
Request to see the surveyor's official employee identity card or government deputation letter before granting field access
Submit all supporting papers solely through recognized channels such as your bank branch, Common Service Center (CSC), or official Agriculture Office
